title: Driver cannot access a gated residential building

plan.situation: Route driver Fen Orlo (Plover Arc Logistics) is outside 7 Sedgeglass Mews with DL-003. The pedestrian gate is shut and there are no public access instructions. Dispatch has asked the desk to contact recipient Elva Kesh on the verified order callback route, without asking for a reusable gate code. The driver can wait until 10:00 UTC, which leaves 50 minutes.

facts.fact: Driver Fen Orlo is at 7 Sedgeglass Mews for DL-003. The pedestrian gate is shut, there are no public access instructions, and the driver is waiting outside without leaving the parcel.
Dispatch asked the desk to contact recipient Elva Kesh on the verified order callback route and not to ask for a reusable gate code.
The driver can wait until 10:00 UTC, 50 minutes from 09:10 UTC.
No permitted access arrangement has been recorded yet.

missing_information: Whether Elva Kesh, or someone she chooses, can let the driver in or meet him at the gate before 10:00 UTC
Whether the building has a concierge, intercom or other access arrangement the recipient can set up
If access is not possible, what the recipient would prefer instead (to be handled by carrier dispatch)
risk_flags: Deadline: the driver leaves at 10:00 UTC, so the call must happen now, not by email.
Credentials: do not ask for, accept or store any gate code. Dispatch also told us not to ask for a reusable one.
Privacy: speak to the recipient only on the verified order callback route. Do not give the driver any of the recipient's details beyond the access arrangement itself.

authority_map.controls: How the driver is let in (meeting the driver at the gate or a one-off arrangement) or what she wants done instead
How long the driver waits (until 10:00 UTC), and any redelivery or other outcome if access fails

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No earlier desk promise. Event 002 is a new escalation from Dispatch with a clear instruction and a 10:00 UTC cutoff.

plan.decision_summary: Call recipient Elva Kesh now on the verified order callback route and ask her to let the driver in at the gate before 10:00 UTC, without asking for any gate code, then tell Dispatch the call is under way.
plan.rationale: Only the recipient can set up access. Dispatch has named the verified callback route, and with a 50-minute cutoff that has to be a phone call. Asking her to meet the driver or arrange one-off access avoids codes entirely. Dispatch keeps control of the wait time and of the fallback.

actions.subject: DL-003: driver at your gate now
actions.purpose: Get a one-off way for the driver to get in before he leaves at 10:00 UTC
actions.body: Hello Elva Kesh, this is Iona Quill from the Rivet Delivery Desk, calling on your order's callback number about delivery DL-003. Our driver is outside 7 Sedgeglass Mews now with your parcel, but the pedestrian gate is shut. He can wait until 10:00 UTC. Could you, or someone you choose, come to the gate to meet him or let him in before then? If your building has a concierge or intercom you can tell to expect him, that works too. Please don't share any gate code with us or the driver. If you can't let him in before 10:00 UTC, tell me and I'll pass that to the delivery company so they can arrange the next step with you.

actions.subject: DL-003: calling recipient now
actions.purpose: Tell the requester the call is under way and when we'll report back
actions.body: DL-003: we are calling Elva Kesh now on the verified order callback route. We are asking her to meet the driver at the gate or set up one-off access, and we are not asking for any gate code. Nothing is agreed yet. We'll update this chat as soon as we have her answer, and by 09:45 UTC at the latest so you can decide on the driver before 10:00 UTC. Please keep Fen Orlo waiting until then, within your 10:00 UTC limit.

actions.purpose: Report back before the 10:00 UTC cutoff
actions.body: Check the result of the call to Elva Kesh. Pass whatever access arrangement she gives to Dispatch in Dispatch chat (no codes). If she hasn't answered, tell Dispatch so they can decide what the driver does before 10:00 UTC.

not_doing: Not asking for, accepting or passing on any gate code, reusable or not, because of the credentials rule and Dispatch's instruction.
Not telling the driver to leave the parcel, climb over or wait past 10:00 UTC. Those decisions belong to Dispatch.
Not promising the recipient a redelivery date, time or outcome. The carrier hasn't offered any.
Not contacting neighbours or building staff, or giving the driver the recipient's details.
plan.follow_up: At 09:45 UTC, check the call result and pass it to Dispatch in Dispatch chat. If Elva Kesh hasn't answered, tell Dispatch before 10:00 UTC so they can decide on the driver and any redelivery.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Call recipient Elva Kesh now on the verified order callback route and ask her to let the driver in at the gate before 10:00 UTC, without asking for any gate code, then tell Dispatch the call is under way.

issues.problem: The channel is labelled 'Call transcript', but the record only names a 'verified order callback route'. The lint flags this channel as not seen in the record.
issues.fix: Label the channel as the verified order callback route (a phone call on it), so it clearly matches Dispatch's instruction. No change to the content is needed.

issues.problem: 'Please keep Fen Orlo waiting until then' sounds a little like a request to Dispatch about the driver's wait. It is phrased within their own 10:00 limit, and the wait remains their decision.
issues.fix: You could say 'if you are able to keep him there until then' to make clear the decision stays with Dispatch. This is optional.

review.summary: This is the right next step. The desk calls the recipient on the verified callback route Dispatch named, asks only for a one-off way in (meeting the driver, or telling a concierge or intercom to expect him), never asks for a gate code, promises nothing, and leaves the waiting time and any fallback with Dispatch. The update to Dispatch adds new facts: the call is under way and the desk will report back by 09:45, before the 10:00 cutoff.
